searchText: When a validator exits due to inactivity, what happens to the ETH they've staked? the validator is ejected but will become withdrawable later, so they can withdraw like active vals can

excerpts.author: tqpcharlie
excerpts.content: When a validator exits due to inactivity, what happens to the ETH they've staked?

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: the validator is ejected but will become withdrawable later, so they can withdraw like active vals can
